'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**The [[Taliban]]-appointed [[Ministry of Defense (Afghanistan)|defense minister]] of [[Afghanistan]] [[Mohammad Yaqoob]] orders a crackdown on those members of the [[War crimes by the Taliban|Taliban who commit abuses]] following reports by [[Kabul]] residents who complained about abusive treatment by certain Taliban members. Yaqoob says that "We direct you to keep them out of your ranks, otherwise strict action will be taken against you," and added that the Taliban does not "want such people in our ranks." [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/afghan-taliban-defence-minister-orders-crackdown-abuses-2021-09-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] open fire using rubber bullets against [[Palestinians]] allegedly throwing rocks towards soldiers during a protest against [[Israeli settlements in the west bank|Israeli settlements]] in the [[West Bank]], killing one person and injuring eight others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/24/israeli-troops-kill-palestinian-man-in-west-bank-ministry (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/ryeqcoixk (Ynet News)]
*[[Insurgency in Cabo Delgado]]
**[[President of Rwanda|Rwandan president]] [[Paul Kagame]] announces during a press conference in [[Pemba, Mozambique|Pemba]], [[Mozambique]], that [[Rwanda Defence Force|Rwandan troops]] will continue to be stationed in Mozambique for the reconstruction of areas affected by the extremist insurgency. [[President of Mozambique|Mozambican president]] [[Filipe Nyusi]] thanks Kagame for the country's commitment to fight terrorism in the region. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/24/in-mozambique-kagame-says-rwandan-troops-presence-to-continue (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mali War]]
**A [[French Armed Forces|French serviceman]], Maxime Blasco, is killed in a [[shootout]] with [[jihadism|jihadist]]s in a forest near [[Mali]]'s border with [[Burkina Faso]]. The gunman who shot Blasco was also killed during the clash, according to the [[Ministry of Armed Forces (France)|Ministry of Armed Forces]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210924-french-soldier-killed-in-mali-in-clash-with-armed-terrorist-group (France 24)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Legality of bitcoin by country or territory]]
**The [[People's Bank of China]] rules that all financial transactions and activities involving [[cryptocurrency]] are illegal in the country. [https://www.ndtv.com/business/china-cryptocurrency-ban-news-chinas-central-bank-rules-all-crypto-transactions-are-illegal-2552286 (AFP via NDTV)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 La Palma eruption]]
**The [[Cumbre Vieja]] volcano enters a more explosive and extreme phase, forcing the evacuation of three more neighborhoods. Currently, 390 buildings and {{convert|14|km|miles}} of roads have been destroyed by [[lava flow]]s. [https://www.elmundo.es/ciencia-y-salud/ciencia/2021/09/24/614d0cd0e4d4d866658b45a1.html (''El Mundo'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] reports a record 1,650 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 84,510. [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/health/1650-new-covid-19-cases-in-spore-three-elderly-men-with-chronic-health-problems (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 2,434 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 295,132. [http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20210924000151 (''The Korea Herald'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Sri Lanka]]
****[[Sri Lanka]] begins administering the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] for children between the ages of 12 and 19 years old with special health needs and [[disability|disabilities]] using the [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine]]. [http://www.news.cn/english/2021-09/24/c_1310207541.htm (Xinhuanet)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
****[[Argentina]] and [[Brazil]] jointly announce that they will be producing COVID-19 vaccines after being selected by the [[Pan American Health Organization]]. Two manufacturing plants will be built, one in each country, to produce both [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|Moderna]] and [[Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer]] vaccines. [https://www.vozdeamerica.com/a/argentina-brasil-produciran-vacunas-contra-covid-19/6243832.html (''Voz de América'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
****[[Government of Brazil|Brazilian]] [[Chamber of Deputies (Brazil)|Congressman]] [[Eduardo Bolsonaro]], son of [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]], tests positive for COVID-19. [[Ministry of Agriculture (Brazil)|Agricultural Minister]] [[Tereza Cristina]] and [[Solicitor General of Brazil|Solicitor General]] Bruno Bianco also test positive for COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-agriculture-minister-tests-positive-covid-19-2021-09-24/ (Reuters)] [https://thehill.com/policy/international/573816-bolsonaros-son-tests-positive-for-covid-19 (''The Hill'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Italy]]
****The [[Italy|Italian]] [[Istituto Superiore di Sanità|National Institute of Health]] recommends that pregnant women should receive a [[COVID-19 vaccine]]s after the first three months of their pregnancy due to growing evidence on the safety of vaccines during pregnancies for both the [[fetus]] and mother. [https://health.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/industry/italy-backs-covid-19-shots-for-pregnant-women-from-second-trimester/86482861 (''The Economic Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 828 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 202,273. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/09/24/russia-record-as-daily-deaths-from-covid-19-hit-new-high (Euronews)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Australia]]
***The number of [[Australians]] who are fully vaccinated against COVID-19 surpasses 50% after a record 347,796 doses of the COVID-19 vaccine were administered in the past 24 hours. [https://7news.com.au/lifestyle/health-wellbeing/australia-reaches-critical-50-per-cent-vaccination-milestone-as-morrison-government-pushes-for-restrictions-to-ease-c-4052703 (7 News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Algeria–Morocco relations]]
**In escalating tensions, [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Algeria)|Algerian foreign ministry official]] Amar Belani says that Algeria "may escalate its dispute" with [[Morocco]], adding that the "adoption of additional measures cannot be ruled out". Both countries suspended diplomatic relations in August 2020 and have had strained relations due to Algeria's support for the [[Polisario Front]] in [[Western Sahara]] and alleged Moroccan support for the [[Movement for the self-determination of Kabylie|MAK]], a [[Berber nationalism|Berber separatist group]] in Algeria. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/algerian-official-warns-further-measures-against-morocco-2021-09-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mexico–United States border crisis]]
**[[United States Secretary of Homeland Security|U.S. Secretary of Homeland Security]] [[Alejandro Mayorkas]] says that the [[Haitians|Haitian]] migrants have been cleared from the [[Del Río–Ciudad Acuña International Bridge|International Bridge]] in [[Del Rio, Texas]]. Around 2,000 of the migrants were [[Haitian deportation in the United States|deported to Haiti]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/migrants-have-been-cleared-under-del-rio-bridge-mayorkas-says-n1280055 (NBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Arrest of Meng Wanzhou]], [[Detention of Michael Spavor and Michael Kovrig]], [[Canada–China relations]]
**[[Huawei]] executive [[Meng Wanzhou]] reaches a deferred prosecution agreement, pleading not guilty to multiple [[fraud]] charges. Meng's [[extradition]] case was subsequently dropped and she was released after spending nearly three years under [[house arrest]] in [[Vancouver]], [[Canada]], reportedly travelling to [[Shenzhen]], [[China]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/meng-wanzhou-us-court-1.6188093 (CBC News)]
**Several hours after [[Meng Wanzhou]] was released, Canadians [[Michael Spavor]] and [[Michael Kovrig]] are also released after spending more than 1,000 days in detention in [[China]] and will return to [[Canada]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/spavor-kovrig-return-1.6189516 (CBC News)]
*[[Jitender Mann Gogi]], a major [[Crime in India|Indian gangster]], is shot dead inside a courtroom in [[Rohini, Delhi]], where a case was being heard against him. The two attackers, who both posed as lawyers, are killed by police. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-58674452 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Insurgency in Northern Chad]]
**[[Transitional Military Council (Chad)|Military junta]] leader and ''de facto'' [[President of Chad|president]] [[Mahamat Déby]] appoints 93 new members to the [[Military junta|junta]], which serves as [[Chad]]'s interim [[parliament]] ahead of a proposed election. Déby says that the new parliament comprises parties previously represented in the [[National Assembly (Chad)|dissolved parliament]], as well as members of the [[Chad National Army|armed forces]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/africa/chad-junta-leader-names-new-interim-parliament-50233 (AFP via TRT World)]

'''Science and technology'''
*In an article for [[Science (journal)|''Science'']], a team of researchers based at [[Bournemouth University]] conclude that a series of human footprints preserved at [[White Sands National Park]] in the [[U.S. state]] of [[New Mexico]] date back between 21,000 and 23,000 years ago during the [[Last Glacial Maximum]], suggesting that humans lived in the [[Americas]] 5,000 years earlier than previously thought. The team also determined that most of the footprints came from children and teenagers. [https://www.npr.org/2021/09/24/1040381802/ancient-footprints-new-mexico-white-sands-humans (NPR)]
